g.text: Exit class drives process exit code:
calendar clock, so every input must be
for a record whose Type Word AND the
next N-1 records' Type Words all validate
Last stage before the writer, on BOTH the
single-file and merge paths — never applied
Never reorders across a timestamp boundary,
so a backward step stays visible where it
(default 4096): at the cap the run is emitted
in arrival order with one WARN (L2-WRT-022).
A cap of 1 disables reordering entirely.
